claims.statement: Public wearable datasets document that PPG measurements are noisy and include simultaneous motion and ECG references specifically to evaluate interference removal and signal quality.
PhysioNet hosts annotated ECG and PPG signal-quality resources and multimodal naturalistic wearable datasets, showing both benchmark feasibility and freely available substitutes.

Hypothesis: commercial teams will pay for a stable cross-device benchmark, private-data evaluation, and CI regression reports even though public datasets are free; willingness-to-pay must be tested with fixed-scope paid audits.

contrary_evidence: High-quality public datasets and open evaluation code lower the barrier for customers to benchmark internally.
Public datasets often have small or nonrepresentative cohorts, but building a better consented corpus is expensive and ethically demanding.

economics.acquisition_route: Credible open benchmark, conference and repository discovery, research-tool integrations, and referrals from device or regulatory consultants
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 40 subscription customers averaging 60,000 PLN ARR plus 25 annual studies averaging 35,000 PLN produces about 3.3m PLN revenue; benchmark IP and recurring revenue could support over 5m PLN founder equity in five to eight years
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly during corpus and protocol creation; cap new data collections and contract operations to stay within part-time limits
economics.gross_margin_basis: Software and existing-corpus tests can reach 75-90% gross margin; new data collection may reduce blended study margin to 40-65%
economics.payback: One caught algorithm regression or avoided failed validation cycle can repay a study; target subscription CAC payback within one initial audit
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 15,000-50,000 PLN per private study and 2,000-10,000 PLN monthly for continuous regression testing
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every algorithm, firmware, or sensor change creates repeat testing; integration into CI makes subscription sticky

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A rights-cleared, versioned multi-device artefact corpus, ground-truth labels, customer edge cases, and benchmark reputation
fingerprint.customer: Wearable-device startups, biosignal algorithm vendors, contract research teams, and applied university labs
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Open reference benchmark, technical papers and repositories, device-design consultancies, and testing-lab referrals
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Fixed-scope signal QA audits, licensed benchmark suites, private evaluation, and continuous-test subscriptions
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Team pays per confidential benchmark study and for recurring regression-test API access
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A new sensor or algorithm version needs robustness evidence across motion, device, skin-contact, and real-world conditions

founder_fit: Exceptional neuroscience, EEG, biosignal, and data-science fit. A reproducible engineering benchmark is compatible with focused part-time work and low social exposure. Ethics, licensing, participant recruitment, and clinical claims need specialist controls.
risks: Dataset licence terms may prevent commercial redistribution or derived benchmark packaging.
A benchmark can be gamed or become stale as devices and algorithms change.
Any clinical-performance claim could trigger higher regulatory and liability requirements.

structure.commercial_archetype: Benchmark-as-a-service and licensed technical data asset
structure.control_point: The trusted evaluation protocol and held-out ground-truth corpus used before deployment or release
structure.critical_dependency: Rights-cleared representative data and buyer recognition that neutral benchmarking is worth paying for

thesis: Create a neutral robustness benchmark and continuous-testing API for wearable ECG, PPG, EDA, and motion algorithms. Combine licensed public data, synthetic artefacts, and consented multi-device recordings under reproducible protocols; sell comparison reports and regression testing to small wearable teams and research groups. The scarce asset is a versioned, rights-cleared ground-truth corpus plus benchmark adoption.
title: Wearable Signal QA Benchmark
uncertainties: Which first buyer has the shortest cycle: academic labs, wellness wearables, device startups, or algorithm vendors.
Whether customers need regulatory-grade validation or only engineering regression testing.
Cost and consent requirements for acquiring sufficiently diverse proprietary recordings.
